newsitem.title: UK: Libya buys two cargoes of Dec white sugar--trade.
newsitem.headline: Libya buys two cargoes of Dec white sugar--trade.

text.p: Libya has bought two cargoes of 45 ICUMSA white sugar at $382.00 a tonne c & f for December delivery, London traders said on Wednesday.
Earlier, there was market talk that up to four cargoes could have been sold following Libya's recent buying tender.
One European trader said on Monday Libya might have bought around four cargoes, one for November shipment and three for December, with prices quoted in Swiss francs.
But there was no immediate confirmation.
Libya postponed the deadline for bids in its tender to buy 14,000 tonnes of 45 ICUMSA white sugar, setting a new deadline for Monday after an original date of October 17.
